clue.text: Curious bears live around Canadian

indicators.note: bears means carries or holds, so the first word holds the next pieces inside it

parts.note: curious means odd, queer
to live is to be
C (circa) is the abbreviation for around, about

explanation.surface: Odd-looking bears roaming near a Canadian.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bears' looks like the animals but signals that QUEER holds BEC inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of the province of Quebec is a Canadian, so the demonym serves as an example of the broader nationality.

clue.text: Turn posh, write with depth

parts.note: U means upper-class, posh
to pen is to write

explanation.surface: Instructions for becoming upper-class: write with profundity.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn something over or upside down is to tip it on its end, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Out to lunch, place with the very thing for dessert

parts.note: out to lunch is slang for crazy, bananas
PL is the abbreviation for place, as in street names
it means the very thing, as in 'that's it'

explanation.surface: Someone crazy chooses a spot with exactly the right pudding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Out to lunch' suggests a meal, fitting the dessert, but means crazy.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a classic sweet course of a halved fruit topped with ice cream, so it is an example of a pudding.

clue.text: Show on day of the week after church, end of July

indicators.note: after says the following pieces come later than the church abbreviation

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
re means on, concerning
Mon is short for Monday

indicators.note: end of picks the final letter of the word July

explanation.surface: A show staged on some weekday after church in late July.
explanation.definitionFit: A ceremony is a formal display or show, as in pomp and ritual put on for an occasion.

clue.text: Arranging dull regime, train climber

indicators.note: arranging means putting in a new order, so the letters of the next three words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Organising a boring routine to train a mountaineer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'climber' suggests a mountaineer, but it is a tree-climbing primate of Madagascar.
explanation.definitionFit: This Madagascan primate with a striped tail lives in trees, so it is an example of an animal that climbs.

clue.text: Finish more cooking after church

indicators.note: after puts the reworked letters behind the church abbreviation
cooking means being concocted or reworked, so the letters of more are rearranged

explanation.surface: Do more cooking once the church service is over.
explanation.definitionFit: Chrome plating is a shiny surface coating, and finish is the word for a surface treatment.

clue.text: Bad-tempered driver crossing river

indicators.note: crossing means going across, so the driver word spans the river letter

parts.note: a cabby is a taxi driver

explanation.surface: An irritable motorist driving across a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Crabby is an informal synonym for grumpy or irritable.

clue.text: Was a candidate's right answer only a third complete?

indicators.note: only the first third of the word answer is kept, its opening two letters

explanation.surface: Asks whether a contender's correct response was only partly finished.
explanation.definitionFit: To run for office means to stand as a candidate, so the past tense matches.

clue.text: Dominating worries about being involved in attack

indicators.note: being involved in puts the reversed piece inside the attack word

parts.note: to maul is to attack savagely

indicators.note: about means turned round, so the word for worries is read backwards

parts.note: frets means worries

explanation.surface: Anxiety about getting caught up in an assault.
explanation.definitionFit: Masterful describes someone commanding and overbearing, a synonym for domineering.

clue.text: This will have Austen on one side (new) and the Queen

definitions.text: This will have Austen on one side (new) and the Queen

indicators.note: on one side keeps only one end of the name Austen, its last three letters, dropping the rest

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen

explanation.surface: Describes a banknote bearing Jane Austen on one face and the Queen on the other.
explanation.walkthrough: Britain's £10 note carried Jane Austen on its back and Queen Elizabeth on its front; 'on one side' keeps the end of her name, TEN.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenner is British slang for a ten-pound note, which featured Jane Austen and the monarch.

clue.text: Precision article cuts tense elastic in opposing directions

indicators.note: in places the rest inside the two compass letters

parts.note: north and south are opposite compass points, N and S

indicators.note: cuts means slices into, so the article goes inside the rearranged letters
elastic means stretchy and pliable, so the letters of tense are reshaped

parts.note: a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: An exact account of an article slicing through elastic stretched both ways.
explanation.walkthrough: 'elastic' rearranges TENSE as ETNES; A cuts in to give EATNES, which sits inside N and S.
explanation.definitionFit: Neatness means tidiness and exactness, so it is a synonym for precision in work.

clue.text: European home is paradise

parts.note: a den is a home or lair

explanation.surface: A European house is heaven on earth.
explanation.definitionFit: The Garden of the Bible's Genesis is the original paradise, so the name stands for any blissful place.

clue.text: Contracted relative to hold party before date is postponed

indicators.note: before puts the date letter after the rest
to hold means the shortened relative wraps around the party word
contracted means shortened, so the relative loses its last letter

parts.note: a mother is a relative
a ball is a formal dance party

explanation.surface: A relative under contract to host a party before the date is put off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Contracted' suggests a signed deal but trims MOTHER to MOTHE.
explanation.definitionFit: Mothballed means stored away and shelved for later, an idiom for postponed indefinitely.

clue.text: Some alcohol and nuts in our balti, cashews primarily

indicators.note: nuts means crazy, so the letters are scrambled
primarily picks the first letter of the word cashews

explanation.surface: A curry containing a little drink and cashew nuts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nuts' looks like the cashews but signals the anagram of IN OUR BALTI plus C.
explanation.definitionFit: Lubrication is jocular slang for alcoholic drink, which loosens people up, so 'some alcohol' fits.

clue.text: Capital city has a proportion of brothels in kingdom

indicators.note: proportion of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A seedy claim that some of a nation's brothels are in its capital.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the capital of Finland, an example of a capital city.

clue.text: Effusive, fancy beau, next to embrace queen

indicators.note: to embrace means the anagram wraps around the queen letter
fancy means elaborate or ornamental, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: R is for Regina, queen

explanation.surface: Gushing about a stylish boyfriend who moves on to hug the queen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fancy' could be a verb (to desire) but is the anagram signal, giving EXUBEANT around R.
explanation.definitionFit: Exuberant means overflowing with enthusiasm, a synonym for gushing or effusive.

clue.text: Hit story about female

indicators.note: about means turned around, so the story word is read backwards

parts.note: a fib is a story, a small lie

explanation.surface: A smash-hit story concerning a woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hit' could be a success, but it is a verb meaning strike.
explanation.definitionFit: Biff is informal for a punch or blow, so it means hit.

clue.text: Something bad indeed, kid's served up Asian food

indicators.note: served up means presented upwards, so in this down entry the pieces read from bottom to top

parts.note: a sin is something bad, a wrong
ay is an old word for yes, indeed
to rib is to kid or tease

explanation.surface: Something nasty, really: a child's been given Asian food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'served up' fits the food but signals that SIN, AY and RIB are read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: These are spiced rice dishes of South Asian cuisine, examples of Asian food.

clue.text: Contest just beginning in London

parts.note: due means deserved or just, as in a just reward

indicators.note: beginning in takes the first letter of the word London

explanation.surface: A competition that is just getting started in London.
explanation.definitionFit: A duel is a fight between two parties, a type of contest.

clue.text: Qualified priest by the Spanish Main retired

parts.note: Eli is the priest who raised Samuel in the Bible

indicators.note: retired means withdrawn, going back, so these pieces are read backwards

parts.note: el is Spanish for the
main means major or chief, as does big

explanation.surface: A qualified cleric along the old Spanish coast has stepped down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spanish Main' looks like the Caribbean coast; here 'Main' means major or big, and 'retired' turns ELBIG round to GIBLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Eligible means meeting the conditions, a synonym for qualified.

clue.text: Before attack, a fellow is scared

indicators.note: before puts the first pieces ahead of the attack word

parts.note: a raid is an attack

explanation.surface: A man is frightened ahead of an assault.
explanation.definitionFit: Afraid is a straightforward synonym of frightened, fearful.

clue.text: Toffee rum put on starter of chicken is secret weakness

indicators.note: on means placed after the chicken letter in this across entry
rum means odd or strange, so the letters of toffee are rearranged
starter of takes the first letter of the word chicken

parts.note: to lay is to put down

explanation.surface: A dessert with rum laid over the chicken course hints at a hidden failing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rum' looks like the drink but is the anagram signal for FEETOF.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical idiom describes a hidden flaw in someone admired, a secret weakness.

clue.text: Coped without man that's old

indicators.note: without means lacking, so the letters of man are removed

parts.note: managed means coped
taken as written

explanation.surface: Got by without a partner, which is how old people manage.
explanation.definitionFit: Aged means having lived long, a synonym of old.

clue.text: Just on time for occasion

parts.note: even means just, as in 'even now'

explanation.surface: Just in time for the big occasion.
explanation.definitionFit: An event is a happening or function, a synonym for an occasion.

clue.text: Plant stem cut with petal getting damaged

indicators.note: cut with means the barrier word is split open and the other letters placed inside

parts.note: to dam is to stem a flow

indicators.note: getting damaged means being knocked out of shape, so the letters of petal are rearranged

explanation.surface: A plant whose stem is pruned and petals bruised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stem' looks like a plant part but is a verb meaning hold back; 'getting damaged' makes TEPAL.
explanation.definitionFit: This tree bearing sweet fruit is a type of plant.

clue.text: Animal accommodated by hotel keeper

indicators.note: accommodated by means housed within, so the letters lie inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A beast given a room by an innkeeper.
explanation.definitionFit: This large deer is an example of an animal.

clue.text: Caught second of salmon in river Dee

indicators.note: in puts that letter inside the river

parts.note: the Nile is the African river

indicators.note: second of picks the second letter of the word salmon

parts.note: dee is the spelled-out name of the letter D

explanation.surface: A salmon was hooked on the river Dee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'river Dee' looks like a Scottish river but splits into NILE and D.
explanation.definitionFit: Nailed is informal for caught or arrested, a slang synonym.

clue.text: Son to accept daughter's bet

parts.note: take means accept

explanation.surface: A son agrees to a daughter's wager.
explanation.definitionFit: Staked means wagered, a synonym of bet in the past tense.

clue.text: Sound reason to rewrite note

indicators.note: to rewrite means to write again in a new form, so the letters of reason are rearranged

parts.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A good reason to redraft a memo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like an adjective meaning valid but is the verb to resound.
explanation.definitionFit: To resonate is to ring out or reverberate, so it means to sound.
